# Earnings Preview

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. An earnings setup describes what the street expects; it does not predict the result. Curated by Skill Harbor: a pre-earnings briefing that assembles everything worth knowing before a company reports, from Yahoo Finance data pulled with the free yfinance library. It finds the report date and whether the release lands before the open or after the close, lays out the consensus EPS and revenue estimates with their low and high range and analyst count (flagging an unusually wide spread as a sign of uncertainty), reviews the last four quarters of estimated versus actual EPS as a beat and miss track record with average surprise, and adds the analyst rating distribution and price-target range with implied upside or downside. It closes with a what-to-watch section chosen for the company and its sector: growth acceleration or deceleration, margin direction, line items that moved sharply, and segment trends. From the himself65/finance-skills repository (MIT). Honest caveats: you need Python 3 with pip (the skill installs yfinance itself if missing); Yahoo Finance consensus can lag real-time professional feeds by a few hours and estimates keep changing until the report date; a history of beats does not guarantee the next one, and whisper numbers circulating elsewhere are not part of this data. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
